brief: Asserts that value is dataType x500Name
description: Returns value unchanged if it is dataType x500Name. Otherwise, including when value is undefined, throws an error. It never converts: to get a x500Name from a value of another data type, write a typed literal or call a to_T conversion function where one exists. This is usually written value as x500Name.

errorsThrown.reason: value is not the asserted data type
